messages:
Ivy (Partnerships): Heads-up: proposing a 'SI QuickCert' sandbox that's focused on marketplace readiness + joint-announcement hygiene. Aim: 2-week fast-track for SIs who already have a reference integration. Thoughts?

Ravi (PartnerEng): OK but keep it strict: must complete a hands-on lab, supply a reproducible deployment (docker-compose or terraform), and pass two automated checks: auth flows + sample evals.

Clara (SI Enablement): Agree. Also add a short PR checklist for joint announcements: logo approval, quoting policy, timing window, and embargo handling. That reduces last-minute legal holds.

Legal (Legal): We'll need a one-paragraph endorsement clause for partner spotlights and a short release template. I can draft a minimal addendum.

Marta (GTM): For marketplace placement, we should reserve a "pilot" badge that surfaces SIs on the new integrations carousel. We can tie placement to conversion signals (first paid deploy within 60 days).

infra-bot: Smoke tests available at POST /si/quickcert/run. Expected: /health 200, auth handshake <= 500ms, sample responses not empty.

Ivy (Partnerships): Nice. Proposed timeline: Week1 onboarding & infra check, Week2 demo + announcement-ready review. Cohort size: 4 SIs for first run.

Ravi (PartnerEng): I'll create a tiny reference repo with terraform + sample dataset. Will tag it: github.com/redwood/si-quickcert-template.

Clara (SI Enablement): I'll prep the announcement checklist and a 10-min training video. Also will run dry-run reviews ahead of any public callout.

Legal (Legal): Drafting the endorsement and release template. ETA 48h.

Marta (GTM): I'll reserve two slots on the carousel and draft copy for the spotlight card. Need one customer quote per SI for the public spot.

Ivy (Partnerships): Action items:
- Template repo (Ravi) [ ]
- Announcement checklist + video (Clara) [ ]
- Legal release + endorsement (Legal) [ ]
- Carousel placement + copy (Marta) [ ]
- Automation hook verification (infra-bot) [ ]

Clara (SI Enablement): Marking JIRA SI-QUICK-1 and will add invitees list. Aim to kick off in 10 business days.

Ivy (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anyone sees a blocker flag here. We're trying to keep this light and fast so partners can show results quickly. :rocket:
